mainQuest.title: Main Quest
mainQuest.description: Become the greatest tamer of the Digital World!

1.description: Look for the Seiryu Leader in Seiryu City

2.description: Talk to Seiryu Leader on Protocol Ruins

4.description: Challenge the Seiryu Leader on Seiryu City

6.description: Go to the East Station and interact with Gondola to reach the next sector

7.description: Defeat the Mystery Player stopping you on the Asuka Bridge

8.description: Talk with the Guilmon on Asuka Inn 2F, on Asuka City

9.description: Talk with the Guilmon on Forest Inn

10.description: Talk with the Tricky Guilmon on Zephyr Tower, on Seiryu City

11.description: Return to the East Station with the Blue Card

12.description: Confront the Guilmon on Seiryu City about the fake card

13.description: Talk to the Tricky Guilmon at the Forest Inn Basements

14.description: Return to the East Station with the real Blue Card

16.description: Talk to Gatomon in training at Tranquil Inn

17.description: Discover who the mysterious being is in the Shaman's House

19.description: Look for Sepkimon near or around Asuka City

20.description: Speak to Etemon near El Dorado

21.description: Look for Sepikmon in Divermon Lake

22.description: Speak to Etemon near El Dorado ID again

23.description: Chase Etemon through the Asuka Sewers

24.description: Return the mask to Sepkimon at the Shaman's House

25.description: Use the Smell Herb to lure Zanbamon out of the Jungle Grave

26.description: Enter Suzaku City and look for an inn to rest

27.description: Challenge Leader Suzaku in the Suzaku Hall

28.description: Return to Suzaku Inn after defeating Leader Suzaku

29.description: Search for information on Lamb Chop

30.description: Look for the trainers couple near El Dorado

31.description: Go to the place where you last saw Etemon

32.description: Report your findings to Kail in the Main Lobby

33.description: Confront the Mischievous Mat at Asuka Sewers

34.description: Return to the Underground Path and find Kail

35.description: Enter the Admin Center dressed as Agumon

36.description: Find Kail in the Admin Center 2F

37.description: Look for clues on how to proceed in Phoenix Bay

38.description: Look for Nami's cat in Bios Swamp

39.description: Ask Sepkimon for help to break down the wall

40.description: Look for Baronmon so he can help you with bombs

41.description: Obtain a TNT Ball from a Triceramon and deliver it to Baronmon

42.description: Use the TNT Chip to open the wall in Bios Swamp

45.description: Challenge Leader Byakko in Byakko City

46.description: Find someone to help you get out of the Underground Cave

47.description: Find a way out of the Underground Cave

48.description: Challenge the true Byakko Leader in the Mirage Tower

52.description: Open the box on the Duct Room 1

54.description: Open the box on the Duct Room 4

55.description: Don't give up! Go after Numemon!

56.description: Open the box on the Duct Room 2

57.description: Does he never get tired? Follow Numemon

58.description: Open the box on the Duct Room 3

59.description: Go to the center of the factory to look for Numemon

60.description: Ask HiAndromon for information about Numemon inside the Operations Room

61.description: Head to the Sewers to find Numemon
